strategy: Add a host-independent durable Skill execution bridge that emits one exact ChatGPT/Codex request, suspends the current Skill step as WAITING_HOST, accepts only a matching digest-bound Host result with structured tool receipts, then resumes the same TaskRun/checkpoint and lets the existing CanonicalSkillInvocationAdapter create the canonical Skill receipt. Add a separate bounded Starter Host selection request/proposal/confirmation protocol so natural language remains model-interpreted while repository code validates one exact entrypoint and requires an exact effect-preview confirmation for mutating routes.

unchanged_boundaries: Skill contracts remain the canonical methodology and are loaded from their verified SKILL.md path
Workflow Registry, graph parser, Capability Resolver, and WorkflowAdapterDispatcher retain their existing single-owner responsibilities
the existing WriteAuthorityGuard runs before a mutating Skill Host request is exposed
Host identity and tool access do not grant ChangePermit, write, Quality, merge, release, or completion authority
CanonicalSkillInvocationAdapter remains the only producer of skill-invocation-receipt@1 for Workflow Skill steps
TaskRun remains lifecycle and completion authority and Graph END still projects only to VALIDATING
Customer Agent Workflows contain no merge step and automatic_merge remains false
generated customer projects remain runnable without Harness
forbidden_repairs: Do not fabricate a Skill receipt when a Host request is merely created or a Skill node is reached.
Do not accept free-form commands, executable names, shell strings, or unstructured tool success claims from Host output.
Do not let Host selection add an entrypoint, Workflow, Skill, capability, provider, or route absent from the verified Starter.
Do not let a mutating natural-language route execute before an exact entrypoint and effect-preview digest are confirmed.
Do not create a second TaskRun, graph, write guard, Quality verdict, merge path, or completion controller.
Do not automatically merge #2095 or any later pull request.
required_invariants: Host request identity binds TaskRun, Workflow, step, Skill path, Skill digest, request class, and user payload digest
Host result identity binds the exact request fingerprint and output digest
every structured tool receipt binds tool name, arguments digest, result digest, evidence reference, mutation flag, and write-authority check flag
Host result submission is immutable and conflicting resubmission fails closed
WAITING_HOST resumes only the same step through the same durable checkpointer and TaskRun
natural-language Host selection can choose only one declared entrypoint and mutating selection requires exact preview confirmation
no Host artifact changes completion, Quality, write, or merge authority

focused: ChatGPT/Codex request persists exact canonical Skill identity and yields WAITING_HOST
matching Host result resumes the same Skill step and creates skill-invocation-receipt@1
structured tool receipts are digest-bound and mutating receipts require write-authority-checked evidence
natural-language Host proposal resolves one exact read route and requires exact confirmation for a mutating route
counterexamples: wrong TaskRun, Workflow, step, Host, Skill digest, request digest, result digest, tool digest, or result reference is rejected
missing output evidence, missing mutation guard evidence, conflicting result resubmission, and stale Skill are rejected
unknown or ambiguous entrypoint, fabricated candidate, stale selection request, and wrong preview confirmation are rejected
Host wait cannot resume from an unrelated TaskRun phase or without durable evidence
regression: Dispatcher, LangGraph, TaskRun bridge, Starter runtime, invocation receipt, Provider, publication, and control-plane suites remain green
complete skill-control-plane and Skill unit profiles remain green
negative_path: no arbitrary shell or tool command from Host data is executed
Host request creation alone produces no skill-invocation-receipt@1
Host selection and Host credentials grant no write authority
Graph END remains VALIDATING and Customer Agent Workflows still contain no merge capability
customer application source and runtime dependencies remain unchanged

risks: A Host may crash after tool execution but before result submission; immutable request identity allows explicit reconciliation without blind replay.
A Host can truthfully attest only tools it actually invoked; repository validation proves binding and integrity, not the model provider's internal reasoning.
Natural-language interpretation remains Host-owned; exact candidate validation prevents it from silently expanding executable topology.
Additional hosts may need transport-specific wrappers, but they must implement the same request/result contract rather than fork runtime authority.
rollback_plan: Remove the Host bridge, WAITING_HOST plumbing, selection protocol, schemas, tests, and architecture record. The existing synchronous SkillHostAdapter and strict slash-command Starter routing remain intact and continue to fail closed without a real injected Host.
